facts.fact: The national agency ANRPTS said the Houwiyeti app began operating on 2 January 2024 and lets citizens issue a digital identity and verify its validity, and public and private bodies can verify QR-coded digital civil-status extracts through the app's verification service.

The national agency ANRPTS said citizens can issue a digital identity and verify its validity in the Houwiyeti mobile app, available on Google Play from 2 January 2024, though passport, ID-card and residence-card services stay blocked pending regulatory texts.

systems.platform: mobile app (Google Play; App Store pending)
